caseNameFull: Randall v. Sorrell Vermont Republican State Committee v. Sorrell and Sorrell v. Randall

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 545 U. S. 1165.] Motions of petitioners Neil Randall et al. and Vermont Republican State Committee et al. for divided argument denied. Motion of respondents William H. Sorrell et al. for divided argument granted and for additional time for oral argument denied.
